answer_4.quote: To validate the accuracy of the approach, three authors annotated 10 dialogues (total of 108 messages) from each dataset. We found that a great deal of the early disagreement among annotators was in assessing clarification vs. follow-up questions. Disgreements were resolved through a round of discussion and reannotation, reaching an average Cohen Kappa of 0.71 across the datasets.
